spans.s:
The सेट् निष्ठा affix is optionally not कित् after the verbs with a penultimate उ if used impersonally or denoting the beginning of action.

Terms: कित्

For the penultimate ओ of the गुण-ated अङ्ग (stem) गोह् (from गुह्) there is the substituted ऊ before an affix beginning with a vowel.

Terms: ऊ substitution
